Baizhang Huaihai owns the retained deployment: teaches that a hundred kinds of knowing are not as good as no seeking, that the way-man is a man of nothing-to-do with no many-moded mind, and that in this ending age those who study the way all cling to sight and sound, so go with him mind-and-mind the same as empty space, like dried wood, like stone, like cold ash and dead fire, and only then is there a small measure of accord, otherwise one day Old Man Yama will rack you, though to leave behind the dharmas of being and non-being with the mind like a sun-wheel always in empty space, shining without shining, takes no effort at all.

Yantou Quanhuo owns the retained deployment: shouts at Xuefeng, snowed in at Ao mountain after his bottom-fell-out release under Deshan's staff, that he has not seen the saying, what enters by the gate is not family treasure, it must pour out of your own chest and cover heaven and cover earth, and only then is there a small measure of accord, at which Xuefeng suddenly wakes, bows, and says his dharma-brother has today completed the way at Ao mountain.

Yungai Zhi owns the retained deployment: instructs that not leaving this very place it is ever serene, seek it and you cannot be seen, yet the sage saying so is only a mold thrown over, fail to exit it and you merely hug what belonged to the ancients, exit it and there is a small measure of accord, whereupon Yungai is otherwise, riding a fine horse around Sumeru, over the mountains hunting ant-tracks, and how many can know it.

Langye Huijue owns the retained deployment: after the patrons' banquet questions, lets the assembly scatter just so and grants that this too has a small measure of accord, though a small measure of accord is still a dull bird perched on a withered branch and a swimming fish stuck in a drained pond, so he raps his staff and asks for the one phrase that breaks through, before descending.

Wunian You owns the retained deployment: writes that merely savoring meanings to pass the time will never cross the toll-gates of birth and death, so to settle the great matter you must unload a lifetime's cargo and dry up the hoarded treasure, smash down through the body the robber-yin demons, the most-mysterious and most-marvelous, the able-to-awake, knotting untransformed in the organs, until with nothing at all to lean on the soul falls flat on open ground and suddenly turns itself over, and when one star of seeing-measure appears, shave it off at once with a blown-hair blade, letting not a hair of dust stop on the needle, and only then is a small measure of accord permitted.

Fushi Tongxian owns the retained deployment: on returning to the monastery, sets Zhigong the monk come now, preaching sideways and upright on the whisk-tip, and asks whether they hear him or not and whether they lack ears, granting that whoever can turn their body and breathe out a breath at this point has a small measure of accord, and for those who cannot, threading one thin line, the seventeenth of last month gone, the thirteenth of this month back, and the winter plum in full bloom on the tree.

Ruibai Mingxue owns the retained deployment: tells the brothers at tea that the work must be thorough to the crown and the tail, never quitting halfway, for like walking a road, wherever there is a path the higher man still walks, go straight to where the water ends and the mountains are done and take one more step, and only then a small measure of accord, still like a general in the field who may have seized the vanguard and captured the rear guard, but with the routed bands unfinished, the moment he doffs armor the bandit soldiers rise again and he loses his life as before, so the dens must be broken, the lairs cleaned out, the remnants annihilated, and only then is there peace.

Senses.Explanation: The first foothold on the way, priced by the masters at withered wood and one more step past water's end. Baizhang Huaihai teaches that a hundred kinds of knowing are not as good as no seeking, the way-man is a man of nothing-to-do, and in this ending age those who study the way all cling to sight and sound, so go with him mind-and-mind the same as empty space, like dried wood, like stone, like cold ash and dead fire, and only then is there a small measure of accord, otherwise one day Old Man Yama will rack you, Yantou Quanhuo shouts at Xuefeng snowed in at Ao mountain that what enters by the gate is not family treasure, it must pour out of your own chest and cover heaven and cover earth, and only then is there a small measure of accord, at which Xuefeng suddenly wakes and bows that today his dharma-brother has completed the way at Ao mountain, Yungai Zhi instructs that the sage's words are only a mold thrown over, fail to exit it and you merely hug what belonged to the ancients, exit it and there is a small measure of accord, and Langye Huijue lets the assembly scatter just so and grants that too a small measure of accord, though a small measure of accord is still a dull bird perched on a withered branch and a fish stranded in a drained pool. Dahui Zonggao glosses Linji's four takings as the diamond-king sword, then sets centipedes, vipers, scorpions, and assorted poisons in one jar and dares the assembly to reach in and pick out one that is not poison, pick it out and you have a small measure of accord with this matter, fail and your own root-nature is dull, Wunian You writes that to settle the great matter you must unload a lifetime's cargo and smash down through the body the robber-yin demons nesting in the organs, until with no support at all the soul falls flat on open ground and suddenly turns itself over, and when one star of seeing-measure appears you must shave it off at once with a sharp blade, and only then is a small measure of accord permitted, Fushi Tongxian sets Zhigong on the whisk-tip preaching sideways and upright, and whoever can turn their body and breathe out a breath there is granted a small measure of accord, and Ruibai Mingxue tells the brothers at tea that like walking a road you must go straight to where the water ends and the mountains are done and take one more step, and only then a small measure of accord, still like a general in the field who must burn out the last of the bandits' dens before there is peace.
